"""Verify the canonical LP and the reduced (no t) LP agree on status/objective."""
import json, random, sys
import numpy as np
import genhard, genfeas, genmax, check
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/submission")
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("planner", "/app/submission/planner.py")
planner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(planner)

rng = random.Random(777)
gens = [lambda: genhard.gen_request(rng), lambda: genfeas.gen_request(rng),
        lambda: genmax.gen_request(rng, "easy")]
bad = 0
for it in range(300):
    req = gens[it % 3]()
    pr = planner.parse_request(json.dumps(req).encode())
    if pr is None:
        print("planner says invalid!"); bad += 1; continue
    model = planner.Model(pr)
    st1, x1, y1, q1 = planner.solve_primal(model)
    st2, x2 = planner.solve_reduced(model)
    if (st1 == 0) != (st2 == 0):
        print("STATUS MISMATCH", st1, st2); print(json.dumps(req)[:300]); bad += 1; continue
    if st1 == 0:
        m1 = planner.optimal_response(model, x1, y1, q1)[0]["mlu"]
        m2 = planner.optimal_response(model, x2, y1, q1)[0]["mlu"]
        if abs(m1 - m2) > 1e-9:
            print("MLU MISMATCH", m1, m2); print(json.dumps(req)[:300]); bad += 1
        # primal feasibility of the canonical solution
        v = planner.primal_violation(model, x1, m1)
        if v > 1e-9:
            print("PRIMAL VIOLATION", v); bad += 1
print("mismatches:", bad)
PYEOF
